criteria.description: vitest.config.ts include glob must match *.test.ts files under src/tests/visible/
criteria.evidence: pnpm test --reporter=verbose lists '✓ src/tests/visible/products.test.ts' with 19 passing tests. vitest.config.ts include is ['src/**/*.test.ts'] which matches src/tests/visible/products.test.ts.

criteria.description: vitest.config.ts globals must be true so describe, it, expect, beforeAll, afterEach etc. are injected without per-file imports
criteria.evidence: pnpm test ran 19 tests across 1 file with no ReferenceError or global-not-found errors. vitest.config.ts has globals: true.

pnpm test produced no 'Cannot find module' or 'ENOENT' error. vitest.config.ts has setupFiles: ['./tests/setup.ts'] and the file exists at tests/setup.ts. All 19 tests passed including auth middleware tests that require the fetch stub from setup.

criteria.description: tsconfig.json must use moduleResolution: bundler (not node) to be compatible with allowImportingTsExtensions: true
criteria.evidence: pnpm build (tsc -p tsconfig.build.json) exited 0 with no output — no TS5095 or any other TypeScript error. tsconfig.json has "moduleResolution": "bundler".

criteria.description: src/server.ts must provide a numeric fallback of 3001 when process.env.PORT is absent
criteria.evidence: Running 'node_modules/.bin/tsx src/server.ts' with no PORT env var printed 'Server running on port 3001' to stdout. src/server.ts line 3: const PORT = Number(process.env.PORT) || 3001;
